brand_dna.category: Farm-to-market artisan dried spices, sold in reusable magnetic jars with a yearly fresh-set refresh and easy refills.
brand_dna.core_belief: Most spices are old and stale, and truly great, fresh spices sourced directly from small farms will elevate every dish with zero extra effort.
proof_points: Spices sourced through Burlap and Barrel, direct from individual farms at a fair price
Reusable flint glass jars that magnetically connect at the base in perfect alignment, result of hundreds of prototypes over two years
QR code on every packet and jar that links straight to the correct refill
30-day return policy and free shipping on orders over $10.00
brand_dna.positioning: Premium, design-led spice system priced at about the same as average grocery-store spices - fresher, smarter, and space-saving.

icp: Home cooks who care about quality - the kind who keep their knives sharp and pick the perfect avocado - and want fresher, better-tasting spices plus a tidy, clever storage system.

personas.name: The Discerning Home Cook
personas.description: Cares about ingredient quality and peak flavor; moved by the freshness gap between old grocery spices and farm-sourced ones.

personas.name: The Organized Aesthete
personas.description: Loves clever, beautiful design and a tidy kitchen; moved by the magnetic connecting jars that free up cabinet space.

personas.name: The Thoughtful Gifter
personas.description: Buys sets like the Redwood Box collection as gifts; moved by handsome packaging and a giftable complete set.

banned.claim: The best spices in the world / #1 spice brand.
banned.why: FTC - unqualified superlative that cannot be substantiated.

banned.claim: Improves the taste of your food by 10, 20, 30 percent or more.
banned.why: FTC - specific objective performance claim with no measurement or proof; state as general flavor improvement instead.

banned.claim: Guaranteed to make every dish taste better.
banned.why: FTC - guaranteed-results claim that cannot be proven.

banned.claim: Rated best cinnamon by thousands of customers.
banned.why: FTC - invented review counts and endorsements; no verified review volume exists in the input.

banned.claim: Only a few left - order in the next hour.
banned.why: FTC - fake urgency not supported by real inventory or timers.
FTC Green Guides - unqualified sustainability claim; site only says 'reduce plastic waste' and 'helps the planet - at least a little bit'.
